tools.name: hubvibe_predictive_probability_engine
tools.title: Predictive probability engine: regression, normal model, p-values
tools.description: Deterministic statistics over (x, y) points: ordinary least squares linear regression with standard errors and confidence intervals, a fitted normal distribution with quantiles and probability queries, exact Student t and Jarque-Bera p-values validated at your alpha, and predictions with prediction intervals. Points come inline or from a BigQuery table (two numeric columns; above max_rows the rows are chosen by fingerprint, never at random).
